name: Glitter Justice
detailed_description:
Robots used to be our loyal everyday companions. They made coffee, mowed lawns, and reminded you to water that dying plant. Life was easy… until everything went haywire.

One massive system failure later, our trusty walking toasters suddenly started attacking anything without a USB port. Ever since then, it's been chaos on every floor. And nobody to unload the dishwasher…

You’ve just joined the GLITTER JUSTICE division, a fabulously armed squad, specialized in robot beatdowns. Your mission: save the city.

A GIRLY FPS

In this unapologetically feminine FPS, take on rogue robots with grace and glamour. Why choose between cute and badass when you can be both? Whether you’re a seasoned fighter or a curious newcomer to the FPS genre, you’ll find missions for every skill level. Progress at your own pace and become an unstoppable love machine.

A STYLISH FPS

Equip an arsenal full of charm and chaos. Toss a glitter bomb for a flashy entrance, fire laser hearts, unleash bubble cannons, or slice gracefully through enemies with the elegance of your cherry blossom-pink katana. Or get weird, launch a cat straight into a robot’s face. Because fashion and firepower should always match, each weapon is customizable!

A… “COZY” FPS ? WHAT, REALLY? IS IT EVEN POSSIBL-

As you protect your city from robots, more and more characters will move in to call it home. Chat with them, take on their quests, and jump to their rescue whenever they get themselves into trouble. (Which, honestly, happens a lot because they’re kind of… well, these folks aren’t exactly the sharpest tools in the shed.) Help transform the city hub from a deserted block into a lively community space.

short_description: Who decided an FPS always has to be dark, gritty, and dreadful? Say goodbye to the gloom and doom and step into gameplay filled with sparkles and vibrant colors. Embrace your inner sci-fi magical girl and shoot hearts and glitter around!
